author: DamiLee
description: Hobbit holes feel comforting because they align with how the human brain seeks safety, warmth, and refuge. Circular forms, earth sheltering, and clear views reflect deep survival instincts known as prospect and refuge. Tolkien may not have known the neuroscience, but he understood exactly how timeless comfort feels. Where do you feel most at ease?
title: The Emotional Power of a Good Hole
